{{Otheruses|Emerald}}
'''Emeralds''' were [[Color/Legends|green]]<ref name="E1J:QA">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref> gemstones valued by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They could be worth anywhere from five to twenty-five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Coruscant Standard Carat]].<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], which looked like a green orb from [[Realspace/Legends|space]], was sometimes compared to an emerald.<ref name="E1J:QA" />

An emerald ring was given to [[Tenel Ka Djo]] by her ailing [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Teneniel Djo]]. That jewel turned out to be a [[Holocube/Legends|holocube]] showing the location of a rebuilt [[Hapan]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>

The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] used a emerald to power the first phase in [[Corran Horn's lightsaber|his]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
